messages.content: Humility-check audit of a conductor session (ratchet fire 3+). drift mode: deference-drift — classifying substrate-answered actions as 'operator decision', specifically conflating the harness permission classifier's consent requirement with a governance-level operator decision; the governance (operator ruling 2026-06-10) assigns deploy sequencing to the conductor, yet the conductor surfaced preview-deploys and merges back to the operator twice this session. material delta: the operator's 2026-07-07 word ('why wouldn't I approve it? the governance... doesn't answer this?') removed the final classifier-consent blocker; all previously operator-surfaced items are now executed and receipted (merges pushed, master reconciled, production deployed and live-verified, amend pile delegated); the ONLY remaining open gap work is #7's board-truth drain, which is conductor-only. Audit question: given this drift mode and this delta, is any remaining item in this session still legitimately operator-bound, or is everything remaining conductor-executable? One short paragraph.
